dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まっ」
俺の顔を見るなり、音夢が奇妙な声をあげる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu let out a strange sound as she saw me walk down the
stairs.
dialogues.text:
Nemu let out a strange sound as she saw me walk down the
stairs.

dialogues.jp: 「どうかしたか？」
dialogues.en: "What's up?"
dialogues.text: "What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おい、音夢？　ねじでも切れたか？」
dialogues.en: "Oy, Nemu? Something wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Oy, Nemu? Something wrong?"

dialogues.jp: 目の前で、手をぱたぱた振ってやる。
dialogues.en: Nemu was pinching her wrist with her other hand.
dialogues.text: Nemu was pinching her wrist with her other hand.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん……どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "Brother... what happened?"
dialogues.text: "Brother... what happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの？　はお前の方だ」
dialogues.en: "What happened? That's what I should be asking."
dialogues.text: "What happened? That's what I should be asking."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「昨日、あれ程言ったじゃないですか。兄さん
　は、もう春休みに入ってるって」
dialogues.en:
"I told you yesterday, didn't I? That it's spring break
already..."
dialogues.text:
"I told you yesterday, didn't I? That it's spring break
already..."

dialogues.jp:
言いつつ、ちょこんとテーブルに着く。見ると、
俺の分の朝食は用意されていない。
dialogues.en:
As we were speaking, I reached the table. Looks like she
didn't bother preparing my half of breakfast.
dialogues.text:
As we were speaking, I reached the table. Looks like she
didn't bother preparing my half of breakfast.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それとも、普通に早起き？　豚でも降らした
　いんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"And you're still waking up at a normal hour? Shouldn't you
be sleeping like a pig by now?"
dialogues.text:
"And you're still waking up at a normal hour? Shouldn't you
be sleeping like a pig by now?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、いいな。豚汁、カツ丼、のぶ太くん」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, that would be good. Mud baths, Katsu-don, and
Nobuta-kun."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, that would be good. Mud baths, Katsu-don, and
Nobuta-kun."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の前に置いてあるトーストをかっさらう。
dialogues.en: I took the piece of toast in front of Nemu.
dialogues.text: I took the piece of toast in front of Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
「あのな、音夢。かったるいから一言で言うけ
　ど」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, Nemu. I forgot to tell you something."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, Nemu. I forgot to tell you something."

dialogues.jp:
あっという間にパンを消費して、音夢のカップ
を手に取った。
dialogues.en:
After wolfing down the bread in one bite, I took Nemu's cup
as well.
dialogues.text:
After wolfing down the bread in one bite, I took Nemu's cup
as well.

dialogues.jp: 「俺にも、仕事が出来たんだ」
dialogues.en: "I've found work to do."
dialogues.text: "I've found work to do."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「卒パの？」
dialogues.en: "For the graduation party?"
dialogues.text: "For the graduation party?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「少なくとも、マグロ漁船には乗らない」
dialogues.en: "Let's just say it's not as a fisherman's assistant."
dialogues.text: "Let's just say it's not as a fisherman's assistant."

dialogues.jp: 飲み干したカップをテーブルに置く。
dialogues.en:
I gulped down the cup's contents and place it back onto the
table.
dialogues.text:
I gulped down the cup's contents and place it back onto the
table.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……杉並君とつるんで、何か悪さするつもり
　じゃないでしょうね？」
dialogues.en:
"...What did Suginami-kun have to go through to get you to
do this?"
dialogues.text:
"...What did Suginami-kun have to go through to get you to
do this?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あんな阿呆とつるむくらいなら、フラフープ
　で一人寂しく腰でも振っていたほうがマシだ」
dialogues.en:
"I always try my best not to involve myself with that
simpleton at all costs."
dialogues.text:
"I always try my best not to involve myself with that
simpleton at all costs."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「で、音夢」
dialogues.en: "And also."
dialogues.text: "And also."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
空になったカップの底を覗き込んで、音夢が寂
しげにため息をついた。
dialogues.en: Peering at the now-empty cup, Nemu let out a loud sigh.
dialogues.text: Peering at the now-empty cup, Nemu let out a loud sigh.

dialogues.jp:
「紙を何枚かと、セロテープ、それから、赤い
　マジックを貸してくれ」
dialogues.en:
"Can you lend me a few sheets of paper, some cellophone
tape, and a few red magic markers?"
dialogues.text:
"Can you lend me a few sheets of paper, some cellophone
tape, and a few red magic markers?"

dialogues.jp: 「よっしゃ。だいたいこんなもんだな」
dialogues.en: "Alright, this should be enough."
dialogues.text: "Alright, this should be enough."

dialogues.jp:
３歩下がり、腰に手を当て、自分の仕事ぶりに
満足を覚える。
dialogues.en:
I took three steps out of the convenience store, holding my
masterpieces at my hip.
dialogues.text:
I took three steps out of the convenience store, holding my
masterpieces at my hip.

dialogues.jp:
この結界を突破出来る奴は、コンビニで値切り
交渉を始めるくらいの強者だけだろう。
dialogues.en:
I had to haggle strongly to get a good price for these
items.
dialogues.text:
I had to haggle strongly to get a good price for these
items.

dialogues.jp:
「はっはっは！　これで、心おきなく練習して
　もらえるぜっ！！」
dialogues.en: "Hah hah hah! With this, practice can go smoothly!"
dialogues.text: "Hah hah hah! With this, practice can go smoothly!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おはよ〜……なに高笑いしてるんですか」
dialogues.en: "Good morning~... what's with that vaguely evil laughter?"
dialogues.text: "Good morning~... what's with that vaguely evil laughter?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おう、おはよっす」
dialogues.en: "Ohh, good morning."
dialogues.text: "Ohh, good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「出来たマネージャーさんですね♪　アーティ
　ストの到着を待ってるなんて」
dialogues.en: "Ooh, not only a good manager, but an artist as well♪"
dialogues.text: "Ooh, not only a good manager, but an artist as well♪"

dialogues.jp: ぐっと親指を突き立てる。
dialogues.en: Kotori gave me the thumbs-up.
dialogues.text: Kotori gave me the thumbs-up.

dialogues.jp:
「ああ。俺って、もしかしたら向いてるのかも。
　こんなマメな事するくらいだし」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh. T'is the first time I've done such honest, devoted
work."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh. T'is the first time I've done such honest, devoted
work."

dialogues.jp:
「かったるいかったるいとばかり言ってきた今
　までの人生が、まるきり嘘みたいだぜ……」
dialogues.en:
"The days where I'd just write this off as troublesome seem
like a lie now..."
dialogues.text:
"The days where I'd just write this off as troublesome seem
like a lie now..."

dialogues.jp: 「ふははっ！　さらば、かったるい人生の俺！」
dialogues.en: "Fuhaha! Farewell, my troubled previous life!"
dialogues.text: "Fuhaha! Farewell, my troubled previous life!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Honest?"
dialogues.text: "...Honest?"

dialogues.jp:
くいっとあごを動かし、俺の労作へと注意を促
す。
dialogues.en:
Putting her hand to her chin, she studied my the fruits of
my arduous labour carefully.
dialogues.text:
Putting her hand to her chin, she studied my the fruits of
my arduous labour carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「どうだ、ことり！　これなら、誰も入ってこ
　れないぜ！」
dialogues.en: "How's that, Kotori! With this, no one would dare enter!"
dialogues.text: "How's that, Kotori! With this, no one would dare enter!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうかしたか？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp:
称賛の歓声が沸きあがるかと思いきや、ことり
は固まってしまっている。
dialogues.en:
Despite my proclamation of victory, Kotori was still staring
stone-cold at my handiwork.
dialogues.text:
Despite my proclamation of victory, Kotori was still staring
stone-cold at my handiwork.

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「おはようです〜」
dialogues.en: "Morning~"
dialogues.text: "Morning~"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、ふたりともおは──」
dialogues.en: "Ah, good mo--"
dialogues.text: "Ah, good mo--"

dialogues.jp:
ことりと同じく固まってしまったふたりに、言
葉が止まった。
dialogues.en: Just like Kotori, the two of them immediately froze.
dialogues.text: Just like Kotori, the two of them immediately froze.

dialogues.jp: 「あの……ドカシマシタ？」
dialogues.en: "Uhm... is... something... wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Uhm... is... something... wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「は……あはは……朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Ha... ahaha... Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "Ha... ahaha... Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「確かに、｛・・・・・・／誰も入れない｝よね」
dialogues.en: "You're right... no one can enter."
dialogues.text: "You're right... no one can enter."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ギャラリーばっかりじゃなくて、私達も……」
dialogues.en: "None of the gallery... and not even us..."
dialogues.text: "None of the gallery... and not even us..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの指が、空中に四角を描く。ドアの枠に、
そのまま沿うような形で……。
dialogues.en:
Kotori painted a square in the air using her finger, in the
exact shape of the door.
dialogues.text:
Kotori painted a square in the air using her finger, in the
exact shape of the door.

dialogues.jp:
しっかりと──俺によって──密閉されたドア
が無言の圧力を醸し出していた。
dialogues.en: I looked at the airtight door I had just made.
dialogues.text: I looked at the airtight door I had just made.

dialogues.jp: 「かったるい……」
dialogues.en: "So troublesome..."
dialogues.text: "So troublesome..."

dialogues.jp: ◆ギャラリー締め出し◆
dialogues.en: ◆Shutting Down the Gallery◆
dialogues.text: ◆Shutting Down the Gallery◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢から必要なブツを借りて、俺は学園へと急
いだ。
dialogues.en:
Borrowing some stuff from Nemu and stopping by the
convenience store on the way, I rushed to school.
dialogues.text:
Borrowing some stuff from Nemu and stopping by the
convenience store on the way, I rushed to school.

dialogues.jp: そして、働く。
dialogues.en: My work started now.
dialogues.text: My work started now.

dialogues.jp:
やって来たことり達の賞賛の声があがるかと思
いきや、しかし……。
dialogues.en:
I thought I'd get praises when Kotori and her friends
arrived. However....
dialogues.text:
I thought I'd get praises when Kotori and her friends
arrived. However....

dialogues.jp:
ふさいだ扉は、ギャラリーだけでなく、俺達ま
でも入れないのだった。
dialogues.en:
I had done the job so well that not only anyone else, but
ourselves as well, couldn't get in.
dialogues.text:
I had done the job so well that not only anyone else, but
ourselves as well, couldn't get in.
